rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for an electrical switch.

example.english: Press the switch and the light will come on.
example.traditional: 撳低個開關，盞燈就着喇。
example.jyutping: gam6 dai1 go3 hoi1 gwaan1 zaan2 dang1 zau6 zoek6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for switching something on, especially lights, appliances, and devices.
Use this for switching something off, especially lights, appliances, and devices.

example.english: I switch off the light before leaving home.
example.traditional: 我出門口之前熄咗盞燈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4 sik1 zo2 zaan2 dang1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for swapping one thing for another or changing places.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wun6 wai2 co5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a switch or change from one system, method, or state to another.

example.english: I used Settings to switch the language.
example.traditional: 我喺設定度轉換咗語言。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 cit3 ding6 dou6 zyun2 wun6 zo2 jyu5 jin4

rows.note: Use this when the switch specifically involves exchanging or swapping two things.

example.english: I exchanged phone numbers with my friend so we could switch to texting.
example.traditional: 我同朋友交換咗電話號碼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 gaau1 wun6 zo2 din6 waa6 hou6 maa5

rows.note: Use this when changing over to a different role, task, channel, or activity rather than swapping physical items.

example.english: I want to switch to the night shift.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zyun2 zou6 je6 gaang1
